page.overview:
Who is Funnier Valentine?

Funny Valentine (father)|status=Deceased|death=2012|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 6: The Island|race=Human|occupation=Astronaut|cod=Escape pod blown up by U-Boat

President Funnier Valentine (おかしなバレンタイン - Okashina Barentain) is a minor antagonist from the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is from the 37th universe and is the user of the Stand, Rear Window. He is an old astronaut, piloting the manned flight to Mars and its secret third moon.

He is the son of Funny Valentine, and the father of The Funniest Valentine.

Funnier Valentine appears with long, curly hair shaped into thick rings. He appears with wrinkles and wears a black uniform. It has three rows of stars, and wears a turtleneck with an eagle on the front.
